records.observed: Reported adult total PMP22 falls 75% and MPZ 50%; preventive NAC returns total levels toward WT. records.anchor: The absence of PMP22 also impaired ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux capacity
records.genotype_driver: PMP22 KO; separate ABCA1 KO nerve comparison
records.compartment: cultured Schwann cells and peripheral nerve
records.contrast: PMP22 deficient versus WT; reciprocal ABCA1 KO versus WT separate arm
records.biological_unit: animals/cultures; exact n, pool IDs and cross-assay pairing not recovered
records.observed: PMP22 loss raises ABCA1/apoE abundance while reducing ABCA1 membrane localization, apoE secretion and cholesterol efflux. ABCA1 loss raises PMP22 with aberrant processing. Reverse genetic perturbation supports a PMP22-dependent lipid phenotype, not mere coexpression.
records.not_identified: closed transcriptional feedback, direct binding from co-IP, acute direct versus secondary developmental effect, human overdosage transfer
records.selection: targeted abstract-level endpoints; prior summary-product calculation not independently repeated

primary_identifiability_result: No audited contrast supplies the full matched endogenous promoter-nascent, RNA-fate and absolute productive-protein-delivery measurements. This is bounded eligibility, not global absence of such data.
starting_position_revision: Both gene-regulatory and protein-environment branches have source support. Their relative mediation cannot be ranked from unmatched endpoints. PMP22-to-lipid direction has genetic support; a closed transcriptional feedback loop remains unproven.
verified_measurement_gap: PMC5802790 P21/adult/NAC comparison reports total protein, redox and tissue function but does not supply matched P1/P2 nascent output or RNA/turnover decomposition. Preventive recovery is not delayed rescue or exact normalization of anatomy.
FDFT1_blocker: Article/source-request prerequisite verified; historical supplement-inventory claim remains inherited. GSE216665 is a different rat injury study, not an eligible substitute for the mouse Fdft1 genotype matrix.

reuse.exact_fit: Same PMC5802790 age/redox study. Reused original XML plus prior author's receipt and causal endpoint assessment, not a new HTTP execution or biological replication.
reuse.decision_change: No duplicate NRF2 signature analysis; inspect P21/adult/preventive treatment and protein/structure discordance.

reuse.exact_fit: Corrected source manifest and investigations.r029 expose FDFT1/ABCA1 prior limitations and immutable inputs. Same studies, not a reanalysis of Nae1.
reuse.decision_change: Do not redo ABCA1 EndoH summary-product; retain broad-matrix FDFT1 blocker and inspect article-level context.

limitations: Agent-curated source audit, not independent replication or novel regulator discovery.
Abstract-only records lack full methods and exact units; all such fields remain unknown.
Reported summaries were not digitized or treated as individual measurements.
Retinoid/metabolic branches beyond the chosen contrast are deferred, not disproven.
Inherited locked failures and unsupported-browser retractions remain in LABBOOK.
